acceptanceNote: 요구사항과 수용 기준의 범위는 변경하지 않는다. 부분 native/broker/학습 증거는 체크포인트를 참조하며, 전체 제품 수용·live 제공자·Windows 실행 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

requirements.text: 한 명의 인간이 native FPS 이동·관찰·직접 조작·협업을 수행
튜토리얼/본게임 분리 및 공통 조작 재사용
수백 명의 개별 생활·관계·약속을 가진 동료/시민
JEV를 NPC 판단층으로 실제 연결, 판단과 실행 구분
별도 생성 대화 모델과 한국어 대화
외부 기억·관계가 실제 다음 행동에 반영
별도 정책 학습 연구와 holdout 비교
과학 모델 공간/시간/단위 및 미검증 한계 표시
관련 OSS의 구체 적용과 기존 도구 재사용
병행 모델링 경계·관측 geometry provenance 유지
기존 native PC/uGUI/TMP/Input System·Windows x64/Mono 수용 유지
플레이어 개입과 자율 NPC가 바꾼 현재 상태에서 JEV가 grounded 원자 전이를 추론하고 미래를 실시간 재합성; 완성 사건 대본 목록 선택으로 대체하지 않음
NPC가 개인 욕구·관측·기억·목표·계획으로 플레이어 cue 없이 먼저 행동하고 결과에 따라 재계획·협상·협력하는 자율 AI 에이전트

acceptance.given: human/NPC/agency intents share a run; role is explicit
acceptance.trigger: submit action and change role during processing
acceptance.expected: one semantic writer; intent acceptance differs from completion; old authority invalidated
acceptance.forbidden: fake citizen agency IDs or two independent writers
acceptance.method: EditMode authority/read-set regression + actual Player action

acceptance.given: two actors request one cart; duplicate intent arrives
acceptance.trigger: reserve/use/cancel/re-submit
acceptance.expected: one owner, one consumption; partial work retained; responsibility moves only after actual handoff
acceptance.forbidden: double ownership or ACK-as-handoff
acceptance.method: domain race/duplicate regression + visible two-actor scene

acceptance.given: tool/part/socket/fasteners and obstructed approach
acceptance.trigger: grab, carry, align, install, fasten, inspect, cancel
acceptance.expected: collision-respecting manipulation and separate installation/fastening/verification states
acceptance.forbidden: camera parenting through wall or animation-only completion
acceptance.method: native mouse/keyboard manipulation + physics debugger + state trace

acceptance.given: two floors, dynamic door, narrow portal, player among NPCs
acceptance.trigger: route/traverse/close door and change movement profile at boundary
acceptance.expected: complete accessible routes or explicit blocked state; single movement owner; persistent actor IDs
acceptance.forbidden: teleport through missing portal or competing pose writers
acceptance.method: actual Player traversal with route/pose trace

acceptance.given: maintenance work with validated or missing device criteria
acceptance.trigger: identify, prepare tools, inspect/change part, verify and hand off
acceptance.expected: actual part/tool/custody changes; missing values remain unresolved, qualified sign-off distinct
acceptance.forbidden: fabricated torque or learned control counted as official approval
acceptance.method: maintenance role native walkthrough and source-revision review

acceptance.given: cleaning area with dirt, wet surface, consumables and personal property
acceptance.trigger: clean and replenish, then verify
acceptance.expected: only contacted regions change; stock reflects actual use; owned property preserved/handed off
acceptance.forbidden: texture disappearance alone certifies disinfection or deletes possessions
acceptance.method: cleaning role native walkthrough + before/after surface and inventory state

acceptance.given: train-service actor with stock and a passenger support request
acceptance.trigger: deliver item, communicate, escort, hand off at destination
acceptance.expected: real inventory transfer and agreed support; receiver physically accepts responsibility
acceptance.forbidden: free spawned item, forced consent, maintenance authority granted to service role
acceptance.method: train-service native scenario with passenger/receiver states

acceptance.given: station staff with uncertain report and another agency boundary
acceptance.trigger: inspect/report/guide/control access/request qualified support
acceptance.expected: known vs unknown facts preserved; visible staff arrival/action/handoff
acceptance.forbidden: staff performs unsupported repair/disposal or global instant completion
acceptance.method: station-role native scenario + typed event evidence

acceptance.given: tutorial partial work and separate active main-game world
acceptance.trigger: rewind tutorial, then start main game
acceptance.expected: isolated snapshot incl consumables/objects/observations restored; old decisions invalidated; same intentId in new generation does not reuse old receipt; no tutorial damage carried into main game
acceptance.forbidden: Done-flag-only rewind or undo of live main world
acceptance.method: two-mode actual scenario + checkpoint/generation regression

acceptance.given: NPCs have different observations and shared interaction history
acceptance.trigger: new cue, memory retrieval and render LOD change
acceptance.expected: only permitted knowledge sent; relationship/commitment affect next action; identity survives culling
acceptance.forbidden: omniscient prompt or memory lost with GameObject
acceptance.method: native NPC interaction + redacted request/state comparison

acceptance.given: valid candidate set plus stale, unknown-choice and provider-failure variants
acceptance.trigger: send real direct JEV request and deliver bounded fault cases
acceptance.expected: contract-valid provenance; invalid/stale results never execute; ongoing valid action independent of network
acceptance.forbidden: fallback disguised as JEV or probability as permission
acceptance.method: schema/consumer integration + authorized live JEV smoke + latency/429/timeout injection

acceptance.given: Korean NPC conversation around observed facts and a pending handoff
acceptance.trigger: generate dialogue and process explicit request/consent
acceptance.expected: natural dialogue from separate model; critical facts from checked slots; real action state unchanged by prose
acceptance.forbidden: free-form statement certifies safety/completion or discloses other actors private context
acceptance.method: authorized dialogue model evaluation + actual subtitle/conversation surface

acceptance.given: initial worlds across accidents, threats and natural disasters with versioned atomic transition rules, known causal prerequisites and existing NPC goals
acceptance.trigger: ground candidates from current state, infer the next transition through JEV, execute with the shared kernel, then remove a required causal precondition
acceptance.expected: only currently valid effects commit; removing a required cause excludes its dependent transition; existing actor identities and world state persist across dynamically composed incident developments
acceptance.forbidden: whole-incident-ID or fixed-ending selection as live synthesis, generated code/physics numbers, incident population reset or absent cause ignored
acceptance.method: native main-game causal traces for all three families + controlled recorded-inference precondition regression; optional Scenic initial-condition/holdout import is not a live-loop prerequisite

acceptance.given: FDS case bounds and crowd solver capability are explicit
acceptance.trigger: request out-of-domain/time or unsupported mechanism
acceptance.expected: model-incomplete; past values labelled historical; exit is not clinical safety
acceptance.forbidden: last-value extrapolation, fabricated CFD response or injury threshold
acceptance.method: existing worker boundary regressions + Player invalid-scope display

acceptance.given: isolated learner uses the same dynamic executor/TransitionKernel and actor-visible observation; fixed background policies exist only in research baselines
acceptance.trigger: train a policy, freeze it, evaluate held-out initial layouts/seeds/roles/interventions/dynamic transitions
acceptance.expected: actual policy artifact with provenance and measured comparison to rule/JEV; termination vs truncation distinct; recorded-inference replay separated from fresh-call evaluation
acceptance.forbidden: JEV self-score as only reward, Python shadow-world result sold as game performance or fixed research policies silently replacing live autonomous agents
acceptance.method: Gymnasium/SB3 run + held-out evaluation through shared dynamic executor and accepted action trace

acceptance.given: clean Windows x64 target without developer repo/venv
acceptance.trigger: build Mono Player, launch services, save and restart
acceptance.expected: native DB loads; packaged worker/dependencies start; crash/disk-full paths distinguish incomplete from success
acceptance.forbidden: copy macOS venv, silently disable persistence or use Editor-only pass
acceptance.method: Windows native build/launch/storage/failure evidence

acceptance.given: recorded target hardware; 100/300/500 individual actors; NPC and forecast requests share configured account and session budgets
acceptance.trigger: run ordinary life, simultaneous cues, close-up manipulation and competing future branches
acceptance.expected: identity/goal/task invariants; CPU/GPU/GC/p50/p95/p99/queue/live-and-forecast-service-age/cost recorded against proposed targets
acceptance.forbidden: claim all-actor two-second JEV response, 60Hz AI, separate per-endpoint copies of one budget or use averages alone
acceptance.method: Player Profiler capture and bounded authorized combined NPC/future load run

acceptance.given: NPC and future-step proxy boundaries accept input and share a private upstream credential
acceptance.trigger: cross-session/unauthorized/oversized/prompt-injected input
acceptance.expected: authorized scoped requests only; secrets/PII excluded from assets/logs/checkpoints; no arbitrary tool execution
acceptance.forbidden: packaged shared API key or loopback-as-auth assumption
acceptance.method: targeted boundary security checks + redacted artifact review

acceptance.given: official/archive/visual/authored/unknown sources and content revisions
acceptance.trigger: author and import a procedure, atomic TransitionDefinition, InitialWorldSeed or geometry binding
acceptance.expected: references resolve and confidence class remains explicit; unknown numeric criteria block only their own official judgement
acceptance.forbidden: silent replacement of unknown railway values or geometry with defaults
acceptance.method: authoring importer smoke + specialist/source review

acceptance.given: stored semantic state, physical-support metadata, model outcome records, candidate bindings and versioned rules
acceptance.trigger: checkpoint, process interruption, restore, recorded-inference playback and separately labelled fresh-call resimulation
acceptance.expected: atomic logical effects and explicit restoration capability; old requests invalidated; recorded outcomes drive semantic replay without remote calls; forecasts never overwrite the resumed live world
acceptance.forbidden: same-seed exact PhysX/JEV determinism promise, fresh model calls presented as replay or audit write failure reported as durable success
acceptance.method: persistence crash/restore regression + native resumed run and replay provenance comparison

acceptance.given: one repeatable initial world with a cart blocking the only accessible doorway, a passenger destination goal and atomic movement/environment operators; controlled inference records are bound to each request's actual candidate set
acceptance.trigger: compare no intervention with the player physically clearing the cart, then blocking the doorway again after a forecast; rebuild grounded candidates and infer each next step from the updated state
acceptance.expected: blocked state excludes doorway traversal; clearing the cart changes reachability, candidate bindings and conditional downstream route/occupancy states; reblocking invalidates dependent futures; actual NPC decisions and revalidated environment effects produce causal live-world differences
acceptance.forbidden: whole-story library or fixed future ending, dialogue/random-seed-only variation, replaying the same candidate list after relevant state change or forecast choices directly moving real actors
acceptance.method: paired native FPS interventions + per-step world/observation/candidate/JEV-selection/kernel/commit trace; recorded-inference fixture proves deterministic causal expectations, authorized fresh JEV run proves the live integration without requiring identical remote answers

acceptance.given: player remains idle; NPC A has a destination and remembered support commitment, NPC B knows an alternative accessible route, and a newly blocked portal is visible only to A; controlled valid decision records specify the exercised choices
acceptance.trigger: advance simulation without player commands, let A discover the block and initiate an information/support request, then let B observe and respond within its knowledge and consent
acceptance.expected: A initiates goal-directed action unprompted, retains the goal/commitment across blockage and render culling, revises the blocked plan, obtains information through actual communication and cooperates via real movement/reservation/handoff; B does not know A's new observation before receiving it
acceptance.forbidden: every action requires player cue, blocked plan silently deletes/completes its goal, omniscient shared prompt, dialogue-only cooperation or unchanging blocked state causing repeated remote replanning
acceptance.method: native idle-player autonomous scene + goal/plan revision, per-actor knowledge, communication and execution trace; controlled inference regression and separately authorized live integration

acceptance.given: live snapshot with known memory, inventory, reservations, receipts and actor decision/action sequences; an isolated branch hypothetically uses a tool and predicts player/NPC actions
acceptance.trigger: advance the branch, change a relevant live door/resource revision or run generation, deliver the old response and attempt to propose its next effect
acceptance.expected: branch execution leaves every live ledger and actor sequence unchanged; changed basis invalidates the branch and late result; only an immediate environmental effect revalidated against current live state may reach the writer; real player/NPC choices remain undecided by the forecast
acceptance.forbidden: forecast memory/consumption/reservation/receipt leakage, stale branch commit, forecast as forced ending or automatic enactment of hypothetical player/NPC actions
acceptance.method: isolated/live state differential regression + native intervention with pending branch and old-generation response; unsupported solver branching remains explicitly incomplete

acceptance.given: recorded initial semantic state, interventions, observations, candidate bindings, exact model outcome/provenance and rule versions; physical playback capability is declared
acceptance.trigger: replay twice using recorded inference with zero remote calls, then run a separately labelled fresh-call experiment from the same initial seed
acceptance.expected: recorded inputs and outcomes produce the same ordered semantic transitions and resulting semantic state under the same rules; changed/missing replay basis is rejected or marked incomplete; fresh-call outputs are recorded separately whether equal or different
acceptance.forbidden: seed plus fresh API calls claimed as deterministic replay, bitwise remote/PhysX guarantee, forcing a fresh answer to match the recording or incomplete solver state fabricated
acceptance.method: recorded-inference semantic trace/state comparison and zero-dispatch observation + separately authorized fresh-call provenance capture; native playback shows the declared restoration scope

acceptance.given: NPC/live and forecast queues share total experimental caps of 12 dispatch/sec, 12 in-flight and 128 pending plus actual account/cost limits; admitted-load service bounds and branch/horizon/step caps are configured
acceptance.trigger: saturate future branches while live agents request service, repeat an unchanged blocked-plan cue, then inject 429/timeout/cancellation and exhaust cost allowance
acceptance.expected: combined counters remain within caps; with a healthy provider and admitted load, foreground/live requests receive dispatch within the configured service bound despite future bursts, not merely repeated deadline exits; overload/fault requests expire explicitly; unchanged blocked plans do not redispatch; branch/replan work stays bounded; exhausted budgets stop new dispatch and unavailable/stale states are visible while valid local actions continue
acceptance.forbidden: duplicated per-endpoint allowance, unbounded branch/replan/retry loop, hidden fallback presented as JEV success, invented forecasts or stopped remote inference reported as normal operation
acceptance.method: deterministic scheduler/fault-clock trace for combined limits and service ordering + bounded authorized mixed-load run and native degraded-state observation; automatic HTTP retries remain zero

all prior four-role/tutorial/main-world/dialogue/memory/learning/Windows requirements and all AC01-AC25

evidence records in existing v5 workflow

parallelismRule: dependsOn expresses prerequisites for integrated completion, not approval gates. After P01, P02/P04/P07/P11 may proceed in parallel with separate ownership. P05 authoring may start after P03, but shared-NPC integrated completion needs P08. P09 depends directly only on P08, which transitively supplies P02/P04/P06/P07; P08/P09 are not independent parallel work. P05/P09 may proceed after P08 with separate ownership. acceptanceIds link contributing evidence; a whole criterion is not passed by every contributing package independently. P12 validates all requirements and AC01-AC25 end-to-end. Parent owns shared contracts; no concurrent shared-file edits without one integration owner.
authorization: No installation, paid API load, Unity/model edits, commit or release authorized by this artifact.
